create_training_args: create a TrainingArgs dataclass to configure VideoCLIP training with dataset, datamodule, and model hyperparameters
create_evaluation_args: create an EvaluationArgs dataclass to configure VideoCLIP evaluation with a checkpoint path and dataset settings
configure_videoclip_args: configure VideoCLIPArgs to set pretrained text and video model paths, projection dimensions, and dropout
configure_datamodule_args: configure DataModuleArgs to set batch size, num workers, and nested BERT and video transform arguments
configure_lightningmodule_args: configure LightningModuleArgs to set learning rate, weight decay, logit scale, and recall K values
